candidate_program.name: small_residual_margin_and_mild_gap_cost
candidate_program.rationale: Uses relative rival regret in residuals containing at most two contacts, then weighted sparsity with a mild normalized gap discount. Base9 computation is inexpensive but remains pointwise.
candidate_program.rule: (weight - max_conflict_weight) / (1 + weight + max_conflict_weight) if remaining_count <= 2 else weight / (1 + degree) * (1 - 0.08 * (station_gap + satellite_gap) / (1 + duration + station_gap + satellite_gap))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
